crime: Every night at nine, one girl sat in the recreation room and cut a prisoner's silhouette on stream, her hands black against the projector's beam. She kept a list of whose turn came next, with {WITCH_NAME}'s name added last, and afterward she carried each finished profile down to its girl in the lounge.
{WITCH_NAME} walked into the lounge only after each stream had ended. She never took years she had not spent.
One night at supper in the dining hall, with only {WITCH_NAME}'s name left, the girl started her list again from the top. "Watch once," she told {WITCH_NAME}, "and cut your own."
A teacher had once promised {WITCH_NAME} a place on the class portrait wall next spring. She transferred again before spring came.
That night at nine, alone in her cell, she watched the stream on her phone for the first time. The girl's hands settled into hers.

The next night at a quarter to nine, she came up behind the girl in the recreation room and twisted the cord of her scissors around her neck until she was still. From nine to ten past, she streamed the night's cut from the dead girl's phone, her own hands cutting the paper silhouette in the girl's unbroken line. At 9:11, the prisoners saw {WITCH_NAME} walk into the lounge, a minute after the stream ended, late as she always was.

In the trial court, they concluded the girl had been strangled with her scissor cord after the stream ended, by a girl who was missing from the lounge at that hour. Then a prisoner replayed her recording of the stream. When the hands let go of the scissors, the scissors dropped to the floor. Every night before, they had swung from the girl's cord. The prisoners realized the cord had already been around her dead neck, and that {WITCH_NAME}'s hands had learned hers in a single look.
fields.epitaph: A single look could give her their hands, but never their evenings.
execution: The execution stand raises an iron classroom. An iron girl sits at every desk, and not one desk is empty. She is chained standing in the open doorway, in the frame of an iron sliding door. The door rolls shut on her. It presses her against the frame and keeps closing. She hangs still in the doorway, neither inside nor out.

magic.name: A Lifetime at a Glance
magic.text: She can watch anyone perform a skill once and do it with all their years of practice.
